---
title: "PROXIOME EXPERIMENT SUMMARY"
subtitle: "v0.16.0"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
params: 
  sample_sheet: "../extdata/test_samplesheet_edgelist_aggregate.csv"
  # One run's output folder only: extdata holds fixtures for several stage vocabularies
  data_folder: "../extdata/qc_jsons_edgelist_aggregate/"
  workflow: "edgelist_aggregate"
  control_markers: ["mIgG1", "mIgG2a", "mIgG2b"]
  norm_method: "CLR"
  clustering_resolution: 1
  annotation_method: "nmf"
  mc_cores: 1
  debug_mode: FALSE
  test_mode: FALSE
---

```{r}
#| label: setup_report
#| include: false

library(pixelatorES)
register_tabset_chunk_hooks()
report <- get_es_workflow_report(params$workflow)
```

```{r}
#| label: preamble
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

for (child in report$preamble) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(child, quiet = TRUE))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: sections
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat("\n# \n\n")
open_tabset()
for (section in report$sections) {
  # Two newlines so the heading starts a new block even when the preceding
  # child ends with a list or paragraph
  cat("\n\n## ", section$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::knit_child(section$child, quiet = TRUE))
}
close_tabset()
```
